title: Poll: which kind of new ad got more first-month spend
hook: Three kinds of new ad. Only one got more spend.
caption:
Three kinds of new ad. Only one got more spend.
Your next brief probably contains all three.

We took every new video ad launched from May to September 2026 across the brands we work with, and looked at how much spend each one got in its first month.

Then we sorted them into three kinds.

A. A proven message, shot in a new look.
B. A new message, over a familiar first shot.
C. A new ad that looks like many ads already running.

One kind got clearly more first-month spend. The other two got less.

It matters this week because sale season has just ended, and December briefs tend to be written from the looks that are already in the account.

Vote below. I will post the answer, with the numbers, in the comments tomorrow.
cta: Vote in the poll; answer posted as a comment the next day

'Answer: A. A proven message in a new look got 47% more first-month spend. A new message over a familiar first shot got 16% less: the script changed, but the ad still looked like one already running. New ads that looked like many running ads got 36% less. A new reason to buy needs a new first shot. Source: Galvor analysis of new video ads launched May to Sep 2026. Read Decoded #3 on galvor.ai'
